dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: Moving dramas, tumultuous trials — The Steambird has it all, today and every day!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And what's the news?

dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: Interested? Well then, buy the paper!

dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: Of course, if you're too lazy to read, you can also look for Sir Arthur. It will tell you about the latest news.

dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: But if you're looking for news that isn't reported in the papers, you'll have some trouble finding it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: Come back any time!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What sort of news, for example?

dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: For example... Well, to be honest, I don't know what you'd like to know.

dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: Could I ask where you're from, and what your vocation might be?

dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: That way, I might be able to pinpoint the information you're looking for.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And who's Sir Arthur?

dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: Ah, and there's something you don't know.

dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: However, I can give you this information for free — you can consider it a freebie for a new customer.

dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: Sir Arthur is the eponymous "Steambird" in The Steambird.

dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: This gentlebird isn't alive, but he can speak just fine.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: I won! Once I finish planning that huge newspaper distribution deal, you'll be selling papers and making me some Mora, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: Argh! Playing cards is much harder than selling newspapers...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Something feels wrong...

dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: Something wrong? I doubt it.

dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: Only when you let me know what you know can I know what you want to know that you don't know.
